'''Hubnutz''' was a short-snouted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] student at the [[Orsis Academy]] who often felt disdain to a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] who was also enrolled there. Skilled in tracking and sharp-shooting, he teamed up with [[Meltch Krakko]] and fellow Rodian [[Fretch]] in a combat mission against Maul in the Vale of Pale Tears in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].

Sporting a [[Mimetic suit/Legends|mimetic suit]], [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]] mask and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Hubnutz and the other two were defeated after Maul had used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to gain the upper hand. 

He was eventually killed by Maul, along with the rest of the school, per [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] orders.
